standfirst: HIV2 is a module name, not a taxon. It holds HIV-2 and the SIVs together, and it is majority SIV: 1,660 of its 2,113 collection sequences and 65 of its 110 coverage exemplars come from simian immunodeficiency virus, not from HIV-2. The module is separated from HIV-1 on layout rather than distance — the two differ by one accessory gene, vpx here against vpu there, which is the project's partitioning rule.

modules.HIV2: Nine features: gag, pol, vif, vpx, vpr, env and nef from PSSMs, tat and rev from get_splice_variant_features.pl. vpx is a gene duplication of vpr and exists only in the HIV-2/SIVsmm/SIVmac lineage; both are declared and neither calls the other.

gaps: VPR is called on 72.7% of exemplars and that is biology, not a gap. Thirty of the 110 genomes carry a single accessory gene in a 311 nt window where the rest carry two in 630 nt, and the BV-BRC reference annotation agrees those genomes have no vpr. VPR therefore carries no copy_num. The held-out panel read 95% because it is mostly HIV-2; the coverage set carries the full SIV spread.
